findings.title: Missing razorpay dependency
findings.description: `razorpay` is declared in `package.json` but not installed. Run `pnpm install` in the workspace root to install it.

findings.title: Webhook signature comparison accepts non-hex input
findings.description: `verifyRazorpaySignature` converts the signature string to a Buffer using `'hex'` encoding but doesn't validate that the signature is actually hex. If Razorpay sends a different encoding or an attacker provides malformed input, the comparison may fail silently. Add a hex regex check before calling `Buffer.from(signature, 'hex')`.

findings.title: No admin UI for credential configuration
findings.description: The `POST /api/servers/:guildId/payment-config` endpoint is implemented, but no frontend page exists for organizers to input credentials. Add a page under `/servers/:guildId/admin/payment-config` or document that organizers must use curl/Postman.

findings.title: Amount unit ambiguity in createOrder API
findings.description: The `/orders` API route accepts an `amount` parameter without specifying units (paise or rupees). `createRazorpayOrder` multiplies by 100, assuming the input is in major currency units. If the caller passes paise, the order will be 100x the intended amount. Document the expected unit and add a validation check (e.g., reject amounts > 10000 INR to catch paise-unit mistakes).

findings.title: Decryption failure handling in webhook route
findings.description: The webhook route calls `decryptCredential` but doesn't catch decryption errors (malformed ciphertext, wrong key, corrupted data). If decryption fails, the webhook returns 500 instead of 400. Wrap decryption in a try-catch and return 400 with a clear error message.

findings.title: ENCRYPTION_KEY validation happens at runtime, not startup
findings.description: `getEncryptionKey()` throws if `ENCRYPTION_KEY` is missing or invalid, but this only happens when a credential is encrypted or decrypted. Add a startup check (e.g., in the web app's `middleware.ts` or a health check) to fail fast if the key is misconfigured.

findings.title: No test coverage for payment flow
findings.description: The review scope excluded running tests, but the payments package has no test files. Add tests for: encryption round-trip, HMAC verification with valid/invalid signatures, state machine transitions, webhook idempotency, and the full order creation + webhook flow.
